event.name: Practicing the Buddhist Path (Sundays)
event.foodDetails: Tea & Mochi Social Hour follows at 8pm!
event.descriptionText:
Sundays, 7 - 8 PM (when classes are in session)
15 minutes teaching
15 minutes discussion
20 minutes guided meditation
Taught by Sumi (Buddhist chaplain), unless otherwise noted

Taking a pragmatic approach, these sessions look at Buddhist teachings apply to our daily lives -- our everyday choices, habits, relationships, how we move in the world. The aim is for you to walk out the door with something useful that supports healing and flourishing in your life right away.

Sep 6: Welcome & Meditation
Sep 13: Working with Stress & Suffering
Sep 20: How to Live Well: The Buddhist Approach
Sep 27: Which Buddhist Personality Type Are You?
Oct 4: Buddhism in a Nutshell
Oct 11: Zen, with Dr. Auguste Fortin
Oct 18: Zen, with Dr. Rebecca Li
Oct 25: Fall Break
Nov 1: Relationships & Attachment
Nov 8: Mapping Your Heart & Mind
Nov 15: Dispelling Fear
Nov 22: Recess
Nov 29: Recess
Dec 6: Spiritual But Not Religious
Dec 13: Bodhi Day Meditation & Ceremony
